title: VDS pin
description: A derived one-way assertion that two named records agreed at a digest. Governed by VDS S-2. A pin stores NO design value: each row carries digests of the two normalised values and an agreement flag, never the values themselves (VDS S-2(7)). A pin fails closed when the records diverge.

subject.description: What this pin covers, for example "control-boundary tokens, five themes".

direction.description: Fixed. A pin derives; it never writes back into either record, and a two-way pin would be a third authority (VDS S-2(1)).

source_of_record.description: The record the pin derives FROM, for example the decided-target Figma file.

target_of_record.description: The record the pin derives TO, for example app/globals.css.

token.description: The token NAME only. A literal value in this field is a storing-form violation of VDS S-2(2).

state.description: Only aligned rows are enforceable. A pin whose rows are all migrating or floor enforces nothing, and its status is vacuous (VDS S-7(2)(4)).

source_value_digest.description: sha256 of the normalised value as it stands in the source record. Null where the source does not define the token.

target_value_digest.description: sha256 of the normalised value as it stands in the target record. Null where the target does not define the token.

agrees.description: True only when both digests are present and equal.

theme.description: The theme this row was measured under, where the token is theme-scoped.

selector.description: The declaring selector in the target record, so an unparsed scope is visible rather than silently absent.

normalisation.description: The named normalisation applied before digesting, for example "oklch to srgb 8-bit, lowercase hex". Two records cannot be compared without one, and an unnamed normalisation makes the digests incomparable.

rows_enforced.description: The count of rows in state aligned. This is the number reported instead of a bare PASS ([2026] VJS-CC-OPBOX 3 D3).

fails_closed.description: Fixed. A pin that tolerates divergence is a store with extra steps.

generated_by.description: The exact command that generated this pin. A pin must be byte-reproducible by it (VDS S-2(5) limb 4).

digest.description: Digest of this pin's own normalised content.

proof_id.description: The token_pin proof result this pin was produced alongside.

kind.description: The named systems of record are fixed by [2026] VJS-CC-OPBOX 3 D1 and are not VDS's to move (VDS S-2(3)).

locator.description: Repository-relative path for a css_file or codebase, file key for a figma_file.

digest.description: The digest of the record at the moment the pin was derived. This is what makes the pin an assertion about a provable state rather than about a moving target.
